169	func (m searchModel) Update(msg tea.Msg) (tea.Model, tea.Cmd) { //nolint:ireturn,cyclop // bubbletea interface
170		switch msg := msg.(type) {
171		case searchResultsMsg:
172			m.loading = false
173			m.fetchingMore = false
174			if msg.err != nil {
175				m.searchErr = msg.err.Error()
176				m = m.refreshBrowseContent()
177				return m, nil
178			}
179			m.searchErr = ""
180			m.results = msg.results
181			m.total = msg.total
182			m.apiPage = 1
183			m.cursor = 0
184			m.page = 0
185			m.browseVP.GotoTop()
186			m = m.refreshBrowseContent()
187			return m, nil
188	
189		case searchMoreResultsMsg:
190			m.fetchingMore = false
191			if msg.err != nil {
192				m.searchErr = msg.err.Error()
193				m = m.refreshBrowseContent()
194				return m, nil
195			}
196			m.apiPage++
197			if len(msg.results) > 0 {
198				m.results = append(m.results, msg.results...)
199			} else {
200				// API returned no more results — cap total to what we have
201				m.total = len(m.results)
202			}
203			m = m.refreshBrowseContent()
204			return m, nil
205	
206		case tea.WindowSizeMsg:
207			m.width = msg.Width
208			m.height = msg.Height
209			m.input.Width = max(msg.Width-6, 30)
210			m.browseVP.Width = msg.Width
211			m.browseVP.Height = max(msg.Height-1, 1) // reserve 1 line for footer
212			if m.mode == modeDetail {
213				m.detailVP.Width = msg.Width
214				m.detailVP.Height = max(msg.Height-2, 1)
215			}
216			m = m.refreshBrowseContent()
217			return m, nil
218	
219		case tea.KeyMsg:
220			switch m.mode {
221			case modeSearch:
222				return m.updateSearchMode(msg)
223			case modeDetail:
224				return m.updateDetailMode(msg)
225			case modeBrowse:
226				return m.updateBrowseMode(msg)
227			}
228		}
229		return m, nil
230	}

232	func (m searchModel) updateSearchMode(msg tea.KeyMsg) (tea.Model, tea.Cmd) { //nolint:ireturn // bubbletea pattern
233		switch msg.String() {
234		case "esc":
235			m.mode = modeBrowse
236			m.input.Blur()
237			m = m.refreshBrowseContent()
238			return m, nil
239		case "enter":
240			raw := strings.TrimSpace(m.input.Value())
241			if raw == "" {
242				return m, nil
243			}
244			parsed := search.ParseSearchInput(raw)
245			if err := search.ValidateRepoFilters(parsed.Repos); err != nil {
246				m.searchErr = err.Error()
247				m = m.refreshBrowseContent()
248				return m, nil
249			}
250			m.mode = modeBrowse
251			m.input.Blur()
252			m.loading = true
253			m.searchErr = ""
254			cfg := m.searchCfg
255			cfg.Query = parsed.Query
256			if cfg.Query == "" {
257				cfg.Query = search.WildcardQuery
258			}
259			cfg.Author = parsed.Author
260			cfg.Date = parsed.Date
261			cfg.Branch = parsed.Branch
262			cfg.Repos = parsed.Repos
263			m.searchCfg = cfg
264			m = m.refreshBrowseContent()
265			return m, performSearch(cfg)
266		}
267	
268		var cmd tea.Cmd
269		m.input, cmd = m.input.Update(msg)
270		return m, cmd

273	func (m searchModel) updateBrowseMode(msg tea.KeyMsg) (tea.Model, tea.Cmd) { //nolint:ireturn // bubbletea pattern
274		pageLen := len(m.pageResults())
275		switch msg.String() {
276		case "q", "ctrl+c":
277			return m, tea.Quit
278		case "up", "k":
279			if m.cursor > 0 {
280				m.cursor--
281				m = m.refreshBrowseContent()
282			}
283		case "down", "j":
284			if m.cursor < pageLen-1 {
285				m.cursor++
286				m = m.refreshBrowseContent()
287			}
288		case "n", "right":
289			if m.page < m.totalPages()-1 {
290				m.page++
291				m.cursor = 0
292				m.browseVP.GotoTop()
293				// Fetch next API page if we've scrolled past loaded results
294				start := m.page * resultsPerPage
295				if start >= len(m.results) && !m.fetchingMore {
296					m.fetchingMore = true
297					m = m.refreshBrowseContent()
298					return m, fetchMoreResults(m.searchCfg, m.apiPage+1)
299				}
300				m = m.refreshBrowseContent()
301			}
302		case "p", "left":
303			if m.page > 0 {
304				m.page--
305				m.cursor = 0
306				m.browseVP.GotoTop()
307				m = m.refreshBrowseContent()
308			}
309		case "enter":
310			if r := m.selectedResult(); r != nil {
311				m.mode = modeDetail
312				content := m.renderDetailContent(*r, m.width, true)
313				m.detailVP = viewport.New(m.width, max(m.height-2, 1))
314				m.detailVP.SetContent(content)
315				return m, nil
316			}
317		case "/":
318			m.mode = modeSearch
319			m.input.Focus()
320			return m, m.input.Cursor.SetMode(cursor.CursorBlink)
321		default:
322			// Forward unhandled keys (pgup/pgdn/ctrl+u/ctrl+d/g/G/etc.) to viewport for scrolling
323			var cmd tea.Cmd
324			m.browseVP, cmd = m.browseVP.Update(msg)
325			return m, cmd
326		}
327		return m, nil
328	}

513	// renderDetailContent builds the text content for a checkpoint detail (no border/card chrome).
514	func (m searchModel) renderDetailContent(r search.Result, contentWidth int, showSections bool) string {
515		const labelWidth = 12
516		// Available width for field values: content width minus label minus space.
517		valueWidth := contentWidth - labelWidth - 1
518		if valueWidth < 20 {
519			valueWidth = 0 // disable wrapping on very narrow terminals
520		}
521	
522		var content strings.Builder
523	
524		content.WriteString(m.styles.render(m.styles.detailTitle, "Checkpoint Detail"))
525		content.WriteString("\n")
526	
527		formatLabel := func(label string) string {
528			return m.styles.render(m.styles.label, fmt.Sprintf("%-*s", labelWidth, label+":"))
529		}
530	
531		writeField := func(label, value string) {
532			content.WriteString(formatLabel(label) + " " + value + "\n")
533		}
534	
535		// writeWrappedField word-wraps a long value, indenting continuation lines to align with the value column.
536		writeWrappedField := func(label, value string) {
537			if valueWidth == 0 || len(value) <= valueWidth {
538				writeField(label, value)
539				return
540			}
541			indent := strings.Repeat(" ", labelWidth+1) // align with value column
542			wrapped := wrapText(value, valueWidth)
543			lines := strings.Split(wrapped, "\n")
544			content.WriteString(formatLabel(label) + " " + lines[0] + "\n")
545			for _, line := range lines[1:] {
546				content.WriteString(indent + line + "\n")
547			}
548		}
549	
550		writeSection := func(title string) {
551			if showSections {
552				content.WriteString("\n" + m.styles.render(m.styles.detailTitle, title) + "\n")
553			} else {
554				content.WriteString("\n")
555			}
556		}
557	
558		// ── OVERVIEW ──
559		writeSection("OVERVIEW")
560		writeField("ID", r.Data.ID)
561		writeWrappedField("Prompt", stringutil.CollapseWhitespace(r.Data.Prompt))
562		matchType := r.Meta.MatchType
563		if r.Meta.Score > 0 {
564			matchType += " " + m.styles.render(m.styles.dim, fmt.Sprintf("(score: %.3f)", r.Meta.Score))
565		}
566		writeField("Match", matchType)
567	
568		// ── SOURCE ──
569		writeSection("SOURCE")
570		writeWrappedField("Commit", formatCommit(r.Data.CommitSHA, r.Data.CommitMessage))
571		writeField("Branch", r.Data.Branch)
572		writeField("Repo", r.Data.Org+"/"+r.Data.Repo)
573		authorStr := r.Data.Author
574		if r.Data.AuthorUsername != nil && *r.Data.AuthorUsername != "" {
575			authorStr = *r.Data.AuthorUsername + " " + m.styles.render(m.styles.dim, "("+r.Data.Author+")")
576		}
577		writeField("Author", authorStr)
578		createdStr := formatDetailCreatedAt(r.Data.CreatedAt, m.styles)
579		writeField("Created", createdStr)
580	
581		// ── SNIPPET ──
582		if r.Meta.Snippet != "" {
583			writeSection("SNIPPET")
584			if valueWidth > 0 {
585				content.WriteString(wrapText(r.Meta.Snippet, contentWidth) + "\n")
586			} else {
587				content.WriteString(r.Meta.Snippet + "\n")
588			}
589		}
590	
591		// ── FILES ──
592		if len(r.Data.FilesTouched) > 0 {
593			content.WriteString("\n")
594			if showSections {
595				content.WriteString(m.styles.render(m.styles.detailTitle, "FILES") + "\n")
596			} else {
597				content.WriteString(m.styles.render(m.styles.label, "Files:") + "\n")
598			}
599			for _, f := range r.Data.FilesTouched {
600				content.WriteString("  " + f + "\n")
601			}
602		}
603	
604		return strings.TrimRight(content.String(), "\n")
605	}

616	// maxCardContentLines is the maximum number of content lines shown in the
617	// inline detail card. Longer content is truncated with a "enter for more" hint.
618	// The full content is always available via the detail view (enter key).
619	const maxCardContentLines = 15
620	
621	func (m searchModel) viewDetailCard(r search.Result) string {
622		var contentWidth int
623		var borderWidth int
624		if m.styles.colorEnabled {
625			// lipgloss .Width(W) includes padding but excludes border:
626			//   text wraps at W - padding(4), rendered = W + border(2), + indent(1) = W + 3
627			borderWidth = max(m.width-3, 0)
628			contentWidth = max(borderWidth-4, 0)
629		} else {
630			// No border/padding in NO_COLOR mode, only indent(1)
631			contentWidth = max(m.width-1, 0)
632		}
633		cardContent := m.renderDetailContent(r, contentWidth, false)
634	
635		lines := strings.Split(cardContent, "\n")
636		if len(lines) > maxCardContentLines {
637			lines = lines[:maxCardContentLines]
638			hint := m.styles.render(m.styles.dim, "▼ enter for more")
639			hintWidth := lipgloss.Width(hint)
640			lines = append(lines, "", strings.Repeat(" ", max(contentWidth-hintWidth, 0))+hint)
641			cardContent = strings.Join(lines, "\n")
642		}
643	
644		card := cardContent
645		if m.styles.colorEnabled {
646			card = m.styles.detailBorder.Width(borderWidth).Render(cardContent)
647		}
648	
649		return indentLines(card, " ")
650	}

```go
s.Document.StylePrimitive.Color = nil
s.Paragraph.StylePrimitive.Color = nil
```

`nil` tells glamour not to emit a foreground colour escape, so the snippet
inherits the terminal's default foreground, which always contrasts with the
user's chosen background regardless of theme. Headings, code blocks, links,
and emphasis keep their built-in styling.

    snippetRendererCache = map[snippetRendererKey]*glamour.TermRenderer{}
)

    width int
    dark  bool
}

    defer snippetRendererMu.Unlock()
    if r, ok := snippetRendererCache[key]; ok {
        return r, nil

    r, err := glamour.NewTermRenderer(
        glamour.WithStyles(snippetMarkdownStyles(dark)),
        glamour.WithWordWrap(width),
        glamour.WithPreservedNewLines(),

    return r, nil

goroutine is still in flight when Enter arrives, the call serialises on the
same mutex and only one build happens.
